works.body:
Thank you for your previous works! I would like to request an image of original characters for a fan-made story based on the “ファイアーエムブレム” series. It is a portrait image that would act like a video game cover art.

In the center of the image is the main heroine. Her name is Ryza. She is a “マムクート”, which is a unique dragon-like species in the “ファイアーエムブレム” games. “マムクート” live for thousands of years but mature very slowly. Their main weapon is the “竜石” (example: https://files.catbox.moe/88mysc.png) which allows them to transform into their dragon form. She is around 90 years old, but appears roughly 9-10 years old. Her personality is innocent, pure-hearted and determined to do what is right. She is among the few last living マムクート, excluding the final villain.

Ryza character image: https://files.catbox.moe/x76rds.jpg.

Updated clothes: If possible, I would like for her to wear a yellow cloak with a mini “capelet” (example: https://files.catbox.moe/jqy6js.jpg). The back of the cloak has decorations. The decorations are multiple golden triangles that represent mountains. However, I think the decorations would not be visible from a front viewing angle, so you do not have to draw them. The cloak does not have to have a hood. The cloak does not need to be very visible and can be behind her usual outfit. As well, the previous design has spikes as a part of her appearance. These can be removed from her arms, chest and forehead.

Pose: Ryza is looking upwards with a hopeful expression. I would prefer if her mouth is open, as if she is saying something. On the left side, her arm is at her side holding her yellow “竜石”. It is crackling with electricity. On the right side, her hand is reaching upwards. She is reaching for a larger, shimmering “竜石”. The large “竜石” glows with 5 colors: White, Yellow, Red, Green, Purple. The large stone is floating in the air on its own. Ryza is not touching it.

Ryza is guarded on her left and right side by two other characters. The atmosphere is as though the two characters are protecting her from off-screen threats that are approaching Ryza.

On the left side is Ryza’s Dragon Form. In this image, her Dragon Form can be shown separately from her humanoid form. Dragon form character image: https://files.catbox.moe/be20vo.jpg.

She is guarding Ryza’s left side and looking towards the left. Example pose: https://files.catbox.moe/ay5e2e.png. You do not need to copy that exact pose. Her Dragon form should look a little aggressive and have her mouth open as if she is roaring. Her wings are flaring out.

On the right side of the image is “Artemis”, the secondary Heroine. Her class is “弓のロード”. Character image: https://files.catbox.moe/jh8c6q.jpg. She has brown hair, green eyes, and appears 17-18 years old.

Weapon update: She is wielding a bow made of black wood. Above the grip embedded into the bow is a purple “竜石”. The bow releases several wisps of shadow or dark energy. It is her special, magical weapon. Her expression is fierce and determined. She is drawing her bow back to release an arrow at offscreen enemies on the right side of the image.

If it looks better, you can give her a green half-cloak with the hood down. However, if it’s simpler to draw her as-is, that’s fine too.

The background of the image is on a mountaintop with dark clouds above. There are Dragon Eyes at the top of the image, somewhat visible through the dark clouds. This represents the final villain, an evil dragon. The eyes are golden, with black slitted pupils (Similar to https://files.catbox.moe/141wah.png, but with gold eyes instead of red eyes). The expression of the eyes is ominous and evil.

Finally, if possible, in the dark clouds above in the far distance, I would like to add one detail to the top-left and top-right corners of the image. I would like to add three shadowed figures of dragons flying. They can be drawn in low resolution as smaller distant shapes. If the color is visible, one Dragon should be white. The second dragon is green. The third dragon is both red and black. If the color is not visible they can simply be dark shadowed shapes behind the clouds. These three dragons represent allies who help Ryza against the final villain.

I would prefer a portrait style vertical picture. Ryza, Artemis and Ryza’s Dragon form are on the bottom, surrounded by enemies that are approaching from off-screen. Far above are the dark clouds and the final villain. In between is the glowing “竜石”, although it is much closer to Ryza. If you prefer an alternate picture orientation (ex. Square, landscape), please feel free. The overall atmosphere of the picture is a heroic last stand, where a small group of heroes fights against an overwhelmingly more powerful evil foe.

Feel free to change any details as required to make a cool picture. Thank you so much for your time as always!

Hello again Yuli-sensei!
またうちのアークロイヤルを描いて頂ければ幸いです！

1. Model: Ark Royal from Kantai Collection.
Your previous art included as reference for proportions. As usual, full-body pic, please!

2. Pose: ref pic included.
Ark's left hand is holding her official bow horizontally, behind her thighs.
Right hand is resting on her hip.

3. Expression: ref pic included.
Looking at viewer with a confident and charming smile :D

4. Background: Ark is standing in an elegant room/staircase.
Example pic included, but minimal details is okay. As long as it conveys "elegant" air, I'll be happy!

5. Outfit: Green outfit from a game, but simplified as follows.

5a. Replace Ark's default tiara with this outfit's flowery headpiece. 
Headwings not needed.

5b. Cleavage sheer part: remove the rings and inner black lines. Just keep the outer black line, to maintain the outline of the cleavage sheer.

5c. Please remove the small bronze accessory from the bottom-center of the bust section. 
Please replace it with a red rose ribbon, same design and color as Ark's official collar rose.

5d. Magic staff not needed.

5e. Please remove the horizontal bronze accessory from the bottom-front of the green dress (right in front of the crotch).

5f. Waist & hips: I removed the original skirt from the ref pics because it doesn't quite fit my taste, so I'd like you to draw a new hip section.
*The original skirt can be seen in subfolder "Old skirt".
I leave the design, color etc. of the new hip section to you (完全にお任せ). I trust your experience here! 
I don't mind if it's a skirt/pants/shorts/etc as long as the top half of the outfit connects well with the legs, and feels "elegant, majestic". Not much focus on sexiness, I think.
*Feel free to change the cut/shape of the dress and the socks as necessary, but please keep the boots.

5g. Boots: Please remove the browns, to make the boots all-white. 
*No changes to the boot cuffs because they match the glove cuffs perfectly as-is.
